description: Compare two supplied HTML snapshots and separate markup churn from a content change. Reports markup that changed while the readable content did not, which is a template or build change; the readable lines added and removed; and changes to the title, canonical, robots directive, meta values and declared structured-data types. Content is compared by line presence rather than position, so a reflowed paragraph is not reported as wholly rewritten. Nothing is fetched. Pay 120000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

after.description: The later snapshot. Raw HTML, at most 262144 bytes. Scripts are not executed, so anything rendered client-side is absent and said to be absent. Nothing is fetched: the caller supplies the bytes, which is what lets an arbitrary site be audited.

url.description: The URL both snapshots were served under, used to resolve links. Used to resolve relative links and to compare against the declared canonical. A wrong value produces wrong resolutions rather than silently relative ones.

name: html_snapshot_diff

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

content_changed.description: Whether the readable text differs. False while markup_changed is true means a template or build change.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

unchanged.description: True only when both documents parsed fully and nothing differed in markup, content or declared metadata.
